name: Shot Freeze Probe (research)
description: Research only, towards a true time stop: can shots in flight be held where they are and let go as they were? In a mission it runs on its own: every 12 s it fires four shots upward from over your Helldiver, freezes every shot in flight for 3 s, lets them go and logs what each did (10 cycles). Ctrl+F11 freezes every shot in flight by hand until pressed again. Solo or host. Turn off when done.
